answer: One concrete defense is to seed trust from a small, hand-vetted anchor set and let it spread by a short random walk. Trust sits at its zenith on those anchors and thins the farther it must wander outward. Because a sybil cluster attaches to the honest region through only a few edges, the walk rarely crosses into it, so even a gale of fresh fake accounts inherits almost no trust. Rank every identity by the trust that reaches it and ignore the long tail the walk never warms.
